question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

CURRENT QUESTION:
where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre",
        "Month",
        "Enrolled Kids",
        "Avg Daily Present",
        CAST("Avg Daily Present" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) * 100 AS attendance_percentage_2023
    FROM
        "attendance_2023"
),
attendance_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS "Centre",
        "month" AS "Month",
        "enrolment" AS "Enrolled Kids",
        "average_attendance" AS "Avg Daily Present",
        CAST("average_attendance" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) * 100 AS attendance_percentage_2024
    FROM
        "attendance_2024"
),
year_on_year_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        a2023."Centre",
        a2023."Month",
        a2023.attendance_percentage_2023,
        a2024.attendance_percentage_2024,
        a2024.attendance_percentage_2024 - a2023.attendance_percentage_2023 AS percentage_change
    FROM
        attendance_2023 a2023
    JOIN
        attendance_2024 a2024
    ON
        a2023."Centre" = a2024."Centre" AND a2023."Month" = a2024."Month"
)
SELECT
    "Centre",
    "Month",
    percentage_change
FROM
    year_on_year_comparison
ORDER BY
    percentage_change ASC
LIMIT 1;
```
